The problem requires a large number of indexed variables (e.g., binary variables for each vehicle, origin-destination pair) and constraints (e.g., flow conservation, subtour elimination, time window) that cannot be enumerated in the required JSON format due to its explicit variable-list structure. The model is linear but the schema does not support indexed or parameterized representations.

The VRPHTW with 20 customers, 5 vehicles, and hard time windows is representable as an MILP, but the required explicit enumeration of all variables (21×21×5 binary plus 21×5 continuous) and constraints (assignment, flow, capacity, time windows) is too large for manual generation in this JSON format. An automated solver would generate the model, but manual listing is impractical.
